about.description: Given names that can stand before a Roman numeral or after 'D.', with their gender. Used by tugaphone.text_normalization.
sources: Wikidata: Portuguese labels of popes and monarchs, and their sex (P21); labels of given-name items (Q12308941, Q11879590, Q3409032). Licence CC0 1.0 (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing).

IBGE Censo 2010 first names as published by datasets-br/prenomes under ODC-PDDL-1.0 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets-br/prenomes/b745134c1cb710bad2b0e4800dce7a1cbb9b478a/data/nomes-censos-ibge.csv).
about.gender_rule: Rulers' sex first, then Wikidata items marked Portuguese, then all Wikidata items. 'both' is read as masculine.
